=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_floor_rules.sh:607 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Uses a fixed `${OUT_FILE}.utf8tmp` temp file name for UTF-8 sanitization.
  WHY: Concurrent runs with the same `OUT_FILE` can collide on the shared temp path, causing races on reads, writes, or deletion.
- scripts/review_floor_rules.sh:607-622 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline `iconv` sanitization block diverges from `sanitize_codex_prompt_file` on all-invalid UTF-8 input.
  WHY: If `iconv` strips everything, the `[ -s "${_tmp}" ]` gate keeps the original invalid file instead of producing valid empty UTF-8, unlike the helper’s fallback behavior.
- tests/test_review_floor_rules.py:214-218 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test replaces PATH with only `/usr/bin:/bin`.
  WHY: On non-Ubuntu hosts, that can hide `python3` and make the test fail spuriously even though the CI environment passes.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
